verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for an LLM observability platform, but nothing in the evidence documents a way to disable telemetry, usage tracking, or request logging. Self-hosting options (Docker Compose, own instance) are a different deployment capability and are not a documented opt-out control. The community PII and GDPR comments raise concerns but describe no opt-out feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
